div.head: Becwæð 2
div.ab: 7: swa ic hit hæbbe, swa hit se sealde, ðe to syllanne ahte, unbryde 7 unforboden.
7: swa ic hit hæbbe, swa hit se sealde, ðe to syllanne ahte, unbryde 7 unforboden.
And as he gave it who had the power to give, without fraud or prohibition, so I have it.
And as he gave it who had the power to give, without fraud or prohibition, so I have it.
Beziehungsweise: Só habe ich es, wie es der veräusserte, der es zu veräussern befugt war, unangefochten und unverboten.
Or: I hold it just as he sold it who was entitled to sell it, unchallenged and unforbidden.
div.note: B's ‘se’ is corrected from ‘te’. Liebermann compares Swer 3.2 f.
